name: 遺伝性圧脆弱性ニューロパチー

sources.title: Hereditary neuropathy with liability to pressure palsies

summary.text: A rare neurologic disease characterized by recurrent mononeuropathies usually triggered by minor physical activities innocuous to healthy people.
